categories.main_business_segments: Empyrean Technology Co., Ltd. primarily develops, sells, and services Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software tools for integrated circuit (IC) design, manufacturing, and packaging. Their product portfolio includes full-custom design platforms for analog, storage, RF, and flat panel display circuits, digital circuit design tools, wafer manufacturing EDA tools, advanced packaging design tools, and 3DIC design tools. They also provide related technical services such as IP cores, wafer manufacturing engineering, and other support services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced EDA technologies including full-custom design automation, circuit simulation, physical verification, parasitic extraction, and reliability analysis. They integrate AI, GPU acceleration, and cloud computing to enhance design efficiency and accuracy. Their tools support multi-technology co-simulation, chiplet (3DIC) design, and advanced packaging with automated routing and verification. They maintain a comprehensive R&D system with over 342 patents and 171 software copyrights, focusing on algorithmic innovation and integration with semiconductor manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Empyrean serves integrated circuit design companies, wafer manufacturers, packaging firms, and flat panel display manufacturers. Their customers include analog, storage, RF, digital, and system-level chip designers, as well as semiconductor foundries and packaging service providers. End markets span computing, telecommunications, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial control, and smart home sectors, both domestically in China and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing, China, with subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Chengdu, Xi'an, Guangzhou, and Tianjin. It also operates overseas subsidiaries in the United States, South Korea, and Hong Kong, serving global markets with a focus on domestic Chinese customers (over 95% of revenue) and a smaller portion of international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Empyrean operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, providing critical EDA software tools that enable IC design, wafer manufacturing, and packaging. Their products support design and verification processes that precede physical chip fabrication and assembly, positioning them as a foundational technology provider within the semiconductor ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment (over 71% of revenue) to enhance core EDA technologies and fill product gaps, especially in advanced process support, 3DIC design, and intelligent design solutions. They focus on AI integration, GPU acceleration, cloud-native platforms, and system-level chip-package co-design. Strategic priorities include expanding full-process tool coverage, strengthening market share domestically and globally, fostering industry-academia collaboration, and building a scalable professional talent pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Empyrean generates revenue mainly through software licensing fees for its EDA tools, typically based on time-limited contracts. Additionally, it earns income from technical services charged per project, including IP design and wafer manufacturing engineering services. Hardware and third-party software sales constitute a minor portion of revenue. The company uses a direct sales model supported by marketing and customer service teams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Globally, the EDA market is dominated by three leading companies: Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, and Siemens EDA. Empyrean is positioned in the second tier globally and is the leading domestic Chinese EDA provider with the most comprehensive product line and strongest technical capabilities. It competes by offering full-process tool coverage and localized solutions, aiming to reduce reliance on foreign EDA tools and expand its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Empyrean reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a 21% increase year-over-year, marking a record high. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 109 million, down 45% from the previous year. The company employs over 1,200 staff, with 76% in R&D. Despite profitability challenges, it maintains strong R&D investment and asset base totaling over RMB 5.6 billion. The company has a stable domestic customer base of nearly 700 clients and continues to grow its market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Empyrean offers the only domestically developed full-process EDA tool systems for analog, storage, RF, flat panel display, advanced packaging, and 3DIC design, providing integrated, one-stop solutions that improve design accuracy, reduce costs, and shorten development cycles. Its tools incorporate AI and GPU acceleration for enhanced efficiency and support automotive safety standards. The company’s comprehensive product coverage, strong R&D capabilities, and localized service differentiate it from international competitors and enable it to support China’s semiconductor self-reliance goals.
